import pytest
import asyncio
from subject import (
    verify_companion_attestation,
    HandlerOccCompanionAttestation,
    ModelOccCompanionRequest,
    ModelCompanionFile,
    ModelOccAttestationRequest,
    ModelOccAttestationResult,
    compute_companion_plan,
    deterministic_fingerprint,
)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_accepted():
    request = ModelOccCompanionRequest(repo="owner/repo", pr_number=1)
    plan = compute_companion_plan(request)
    observed_files = getattr(plan, "companion_files", ())
    result = verify_companion_attestation(observed_files, request)
    assert result.accepted is True
    assert result.observed_digest == result.expected_digest
    assert "ACCEPTED" in result.reason
    assert f"repo={request.repo}#{request.pr_number}" in result.reason


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_verify_companion_attestation_rejected():
    request = ModelOccCompanionRequest(repo="owner/repo", pr_number=2)
    plan = compute_companion_plan(request)
    dummy_file = ModelCompanionFile(path="unexpected.txt", content=b"bad")
    observed_files = (dummy_file,)
    result = verify_companion_attestation(observed_files, request)
    assert result.accepted is False
    assert result.observed_digest != result.expected_digest
    assert "REJECTED" in result.reason
    assert f"repo={request.repo}#{request.pr_number}" in result.reason


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_handler_handle():
    expected_req = ModelOccCompanionRequest(repo="owner/repo", pr_number=3)
    observed = ()
    att_req = ModelOccAttestationRequest(expected=expected_req, observed_files=observed)
    handler = HandlerOccCompanionAttestation()

    assert result.reason == expected_result.reason
